findings.title: the committed spec record still specifies the superseded design and contradicts the shipped schema
findings.disposition_rationale: Valid. Appended a Product-owner override (2026-10-14) section to the committed spec record naming the objects-only decision, the retained FAFF-959 row and each superseded spec passage (commit c3bec8ec).

findings.title: the entry-level schema description "any keys, any JSON values" can be read as permitting non-object entries
findings.disposition_rationale: Valid. Reworded the entry description in both schema copies to state the entry must be an object, with any keys and any JSON values inside it; byte-identity test still passes (commit c3bec8ec).

findings.title: no size or depth bound on the now-accepted nested content
findings.disposition_rationale: The closed schema it replaces bounded neither string length nor nesting depth of the values it allowed, so opening the keys adds no new unbounded dimension that did not already exist for string values; writers are CLI code and SKILL-prose agents, and the spec scopes writer changes out. A writer-side bound would be a separate ticket.
